# Better Map

> Splunk Dashboard Studio custom map visualization built on MapLibre GL JS — ten layer types, time scrubber, 3D extrusion, H3 hexbin aggregation, vector-tile feature join, cross-panel coordination, indoor floor-plan overlay, and twelve preset Studio dashboards.

Better Map is a Splunk Dashboard Studio v2 custom map visualization built on MapLibre GL JS. The project is documented in two layers: human-readable pages rendered as a Material site (this `llms.txt` indexes them) and a structured machine-readable layer under `docs/_machine/` (JSON Schema for the 83 formatter options, YAML scaffolds for each Splunk integration, YAML index of per-source recipes). Every entry below resolves to a single page; the structured machine-readable files are linked at the bottom for agents that would rather consume the contract directly than read prose.

All URLs below are publicly accessible; the project ships under the MIT licence and the source repo is at <https://github.com/fenre/better_map>.

## Agent guide

- [Agent operating guide](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/_machine/agents/): the five non-negotiables (formatter schema / manifest / CSS contract / dashboard tokens / BM-CT-1), the runtime envelope, how to add a formatter option / integration / recipe, the pre-commit checklist, and the common mistake → fix table.
- [Machine-readable layer contract](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/_machine/): what each file under `docs/_machine/` documents, what its source of truth is, and which CI gate prevents drift.

## Reference

- [Layer reference](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/reference/layers/)

## Runtime envelope (binding)

- [Runtime envelope](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/runtime-envelope/): the binding constraints on what better_map can do (Dashboard Studio v2 only, single AMD bundle, CSP / `connect-src 'self'`, no external fetches outside basemap tiles / air-gapped PMTiles / declared integrations, no Web Workers from cross-origin URLs, no Dashboard Studio v3 `core.*` keys). Read this BEFORE proposing any architectural change.

## Integrations (Splunk)

- [Overview](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/integrations/)
- [Catalogue](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/integrations/catalogue/)

Each integration also has a machine-readable scaffold under `docs/_machine/integrations/` mirroring the JS module it shadows in `src/lib/splunk/`. The full directory is at <https://github.com/fenre/better_map/tree/main/docs/_machine/integrations>.

- [Splunk AI Assistant for SPL — natural-language → SPL (experimental)](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/docs/_machine/integrations/aiAssistant.yaml): requires `Splunk_AI_Assistant_Cloud`. Source: `better_map/appserver/static/visualizations/better_map/src/lib/splunk/aiAssistant.js`.
- [AI-suggested geo annotations (experimental)](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/docs/_machine/integrations/aiGeo.yaml): requires `Splunk AI Assistant for SPL OR generic Splunk Cloud ML Toolkit endpoint`. Source: `better_map/appserver/static/visualizations/better_map/src/lib/splunk/aiGeo.js`.
- [ES Notable Event — drilldown URL builder + close stub (experimental)](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/docs/_machine/integrations/esNotable.yaml): requires `Splunk Enterprise Security`. Source: `better_map/appserver/static/visualizations/better_map/src/lib/splunk/esNotable.js`.
- [Splunk IT Service Intelligence (ITSI) — service map (experimental)](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/docs/_machine/integrations/itsi.yaml): requires `ITSI (SA-ITOA)`. Source: `better_map/appserver/static/visualizations/better_map/src/lib/splunk/itsi.js`.
- [MITRE ATT&CK technique overlay (experimental)](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/docs/_machine/integrations/mitre.yaml): requires `none (built-in lookup table for ~80 most-common techniques)`. Source: `better_map/appserver/static/visualizations/better_map/src/lib/splunk/mitre.js`.
- [OT Purdue model / IEC 62443 overlay (experimental)](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/docs/_machine/integrations/purdue.yaml): requires `none (asset register can come from any Splunk lookup or inline)`. Source: `better_map/appserver/static/visualizations/better_map/src/lib/splunk/purdue.js`.
- [Risk-Based Alerting (RBA) — geo risk heatmap (experimental)](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/docs/_machine/integrations/rba.yaml): requires `Splunk Enterprise Security (uses ES Risk Framework schema)`. Source: `better_map/appserver/static/visualizations/better_map/src/lib/splunk/rba.js`.
- [Splunk SOAR (formerly Phantom) — right-click playbook trigger (experimental)](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/docs/_machine/integrations/soar.yaml): requires `Splunk SOAR forwarder app (phantom_forward) on the host Splunk`. Source: `better_map/appserver/static/visualizations/better_map/src/lib/splunk/soar.js`.

## Recipes (per-source playbooks)

- [Recipes overview](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/recipes/): the recipe contract, the six-section structure, the CI gate, the JSON Schema, and how to add a new recipe. The machine-readable index of every shipped recipe is at <https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/docs/_machine/recipes/index.yaml>.
- [CIM Network Traffic → Markers (unverified)](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/recipes/cim-network-traffic/markers/): apps required: Splunk_SA_CIM, builtin:iplocation.
- [CSV lookup (geo polygons) → Polygons (unverified)](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/recipes/csv-lookup-geo/polygons/): apps required: none.
- [US states (built-in geo lookup) → Choropleth (unverified)](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/recipes/geo-us-states/choropleth/): apps required: none.
- [KV Store (lat/lon collection) → Markers (unverified)](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/recipes/kvstore-latlon/markers/): apps required: none.
- [NetFlow / sFlow / IPFIX (flow records) → H3 hexbin (unverified)](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/recipes/netflow-sflow-ipfix/h3/): apps required: Splunk_TA_netflow, builtin:iplocation.
- [Splunk Stream (wire data) → Markers (unverified)](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/recipes/splunk-stream/markers/): apps required: Splunk_TA_stream, splunk_app_stream, builtin:iplocation.

## Machine-readable layer (`docs/_machine/`)

Every file below is either auto-generated from a source of truth elsewhere in the repo OR hand-maintained with that fact declared in a `meta:` block. Either way the contents are stable enough to be diffed in CI; the corresponding drift gates live in `scripts/check-*.py`. The README is at <https://fenre.github.io/better_map/_machine/>.

- [`formatter-schema.json`](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/docs/_machine/formatter-schema.json): JSON Schema 2020-12 for the 83 formatter options. Generated from `formatter.html`. Drift gate: `scripts/check-formatter-schema.py`.
- [`integrations/`](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/tree/main/docs/_machine/integrations): 8 hand-authored YAML scaffolds, one per Splunk integration in `src/lib/splunk/`.
- [`recipes/recipe-schema.json`](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/docs/_machine/recipes/recipe-schema.json): JSON Schema 2020-12 for the YAML frontmatter every recipe MUST carry. Hand-maintained.
- [`recipes/index.yaml`](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/docs/_machine/recipes/index.yaml): auto-generated index of every recipe under `docs/recipes/`. Drift gate: `scripts/check-recipe-schema.py`.
- [`agents.md`](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/_machine/agents/): operating guide for AI agents working on the repository itself.
- [`README.md`](https://fenre.github.io/better_map/_machine/): the `_machine/` contract — what's here, what's not, how to consume it.

- [Changelog](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): per-release summary, in Keep a Changelog format.
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT.
- [Repository](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/tree/main): the canonical source tree.

## Optional

- [Air-gapped PMTiles build](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/blob/main/better_map/appserver/static/visualizations/better_map/AIR-GAPPED-PMTILES.md): advanced operator runbook for fully-offline basemap deployment.
- [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/tree/main/.github/workflows): every CI gate documented in the agents.md pre-commit checklist is wired into one of these workflows.
- [Cursor rules](https://github.com/fenre/better_map/tree/main/.cursor/rules): repo-local rules for AI agents working in Cursor. Includes the binding OT-safety boundary at `ot-safety.mdc`.
